findings.title: Fallback locales are only loaded for web requests; background jobs and mailers will emit 'translation missing'
findings.body: The translate accelerator only loads the YAML files for `config.locale` on demand (see `translate`, which calls `load_locale(config.locale)` only). The new fallback mechanism relies on `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` to load the fallback locales (site default locale and `:en`), but that is only invoked from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. Any `I18n.t` call that happens outside a web request — Sidekiq jobs, digest/notification emails, rake tasks — with a locale whose translation only exists in the fallback locale (e.g. `:en`) will not have the fallback locale's files loaded, so the lookup returns a 'translation missing' string instead of falling back correctly. The fallback loading should happen inside the backend/translate path (or a central `with_locale`/`ensure_loaded!` hook) rather than only in the controller before_filter.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList#[] raises NoMethodError when SiteSetting.default_locale is blank
findings.body: `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` calls `.to_sym` on `SiteSetting.default_locale` before the `compact` runs. If the setting is ever nil or unset (fresh install, broken settings table, early boot before seeding), every translation lookup that goes through the fallbacks backend will raise NoMethodError. Guard with `SiteSetting.default_locale.presence&.to_sym` (or only add it when present). Also note `locale` may be a String while the other entries are Symbols, so `uniq` will not deduplicate e.g. 'en' vs :en — harmless but wasteful; normalize to symbols.

findings.title: No tests for fallback ordering or lazy loading of fallback locales
findings.body: This PR introduces custom fallback behavior (user locale → site default locale → :en) and a new `ensure_loaded!` code path, but adds no specs. Given that the lazy locale loader (translate_accelerator) and the fallbacks interact in non-obvious ways (e.g. fallback locale files must be explicitly loaded or lookups return 'translation missing'), a regression test covering a key that exists only in :en being resolved for a request in another locale — plus the background-job path — would catch the most likely failure modes.
